text:
The spawn-parent proposal is clear, so I made no rewrite. `node Server/text-check.mjs` flagged nothing. The title and first paragraph say what's wrong, and the steps and fences are short.

I logged one `clear` line in `.claude/skills/clarity/flags.jsonl`.

Verdict: **fix**. The cause is found, but the fix only covers agents that Servex starts. A VS Code tab can still spawn an agent whose parent is recorded as `voice-app`. The report is at `public/framework/ai/sessions/2026/10/20/session-e00f55c9/spawn-parent/review.md`.

**What the work does:** the builder found that the claude.ai "Servex" connector loads in every agent, and every call through it is labelled `voice-app`. A spawn made that way got `voice-app` as its parent. The fix blocks that connector for agents Servex starts (`Servex/agents/Agents.js:1444`) and documents the rule in `Servex/agents/doc/architecture.md`.

**Must change:**
1. **Tabs are still affected.** `spawn_agent` takes the caller's label before the tab's own session id (`Servex/agents/tools.js:394` vs `:397`), so a tab spawning through the connector still gets `voice-app`. The simpler fix is at the source: let the tab's session id win when the caller is `voice-app`, or have the remote door use `voice-app` only for real voice sessions.
2. **No reproduction, and the test doesn't check the parent.** The changed test only checks that the connector's name is in the blocked list. Nothing proves a spawn now records the right parent.
3. **The task folder can't be picked up by someone else.** `session.jsonl` holds only the start line and two commit stamps. There is no diagnosis, no test run and no outcome.

**Worth a look:**
- **Test not run by me:** the worktree has no `Servex/node_modules`, so the new test fails there with a missing-module error. It has probably not been run on this branch either.
- **Doc location:** the rule went into `agents/doc/architecture.md`, not Servex's readme as the brief asked. `Servex/ext/remote/readme.md` doesn't mention the `voice-app` labelling at all.
- **Same mislabel elsewhere:** `fork_self`, `start_job` and `follow` also fall back to the caller's label. A fix at the source (point 1) would cover them too.
- **Blocking is unproven live:** it relies on the SDK matching a whole server by name. My own session still lists the connector's tools, which fits the diagnosis; one spawn after a Servex restart would prove the fix.
- **Overnight note:** the "Found overnight" note in the night brief should link to this task once it lands.

Verdict: **fix**. The code fix looks right, but two things from the first review are still open. The report is at `public/framework/ai/sessions/2026/10/20/session-e00f55c9/spawn-parent/review.md`.

**Must change:**
1. **The task folder still can't be picked up by someone else.** `session.jsonl` has no diagnosis, no record of a test run and no outcome line.
2. **No one has shown the tests pass.** The worktree still has no `Servex/node_modules`, so both tests stop with a missing-module error when I run them. A hook blocked me from linking the main tree's modules into the worktree. Nothing in the folder records a passing run anywhere else.

**What's now fixed from the first review:**
- **Tabs:** a tab's own `session_id` now beats the `voice-app` label (`Servex/agents/tools.js:397`).
- **A real test:** `spawn-parent.test.mjs` checks the recorded parent in five cases. Reading the code, all five should pass, but I couldn't run it.

**Worth a look:**
- **Misplaced comment:** `tab_parent`'s comment now sits above the new `REMOTE_CALLER` constant instead of the function.
- **Copied value:** `REMOTE_CALLER` repeats `RemoteMCP.CALLER` by hand, so if one changes, the other silently stops matching.
- **Same bug elsewhere:** `policy.spawn`, `fork_self`, `start_job` and `follow` still treat a tab's call through the connector as `voice-app`.
- **Doc location:** the rule went into `Servex/agents/doc/architecture.md`, not the readme where spawning is described, and the remote door's readme doesn't mention the new rule.
- **Overnight note:** the "Found overnight" entry in the night brief should link to this task once it lands.
- **Live proof:** blocking the connector for agents is still unproven until one spawn after a Servex restart lists its tools.

Verdict: **fix**. The code does what the brief asks, but the task folder still doesn't record the cause, the test results or a landing line.

**Must change:**
- **The task folder can't be picked up by someone else.** `spawn-parent/session.jsonl` has no diagnosis line, no test result and no landing line. Both earlier reviews raised this, and it is still open. The cause it should record: the owner's claude.ai "Servex" connector reaches Servex through the remote door, which labels every call `voice-app`.

**Worth a look:**
- **The tests pass on the branch.** The builder's worktree has no installed packages, so the builder never ran them. I ran them in a throwaway worktree with its own packages, then removed it:
  - `spawn-parent.test.mjs`: 5 checks passed.
  - `item-local.test.mjs`: 6 checks passed.
  - `RemoteMCP.test.mjs`: 7 calls ok.
- **All four asks are met in code:**
  - Agents can no longer use the connector (`Agents.js:1446`).
  - A tab's `session_id` now outranks `voice-app` (`tools.js:397`).
  - The rule is in `Servex/agents/readme.md`, linking to `doc/architecture.md`.
  - Step 3 (merge) hasn't happened yet; this is its third review.
- **Not proven in a real spawn:**
  - Nothing shows the step-4 builder's spawn really came through the remote door.
  - The connector block only takes effect after a Servex restart. I still have the `mcp__claude_ai_Servex__*` tools.
  - After the restart, check one spawned agent's tools and the parent recorded for it.
- **Small items:**
  - `tab_parent` is now exported, but nothing imports it.
  - Spawn permission (`policy.spawn`), `start_job`, `fork_self` and `follow` still treat a tab using the connector as `voice-app`. That wasn't asked for, but it has the same cause, so it's worth a follow-up task.
  - `night-2026-11-01/requirements.md` still lists this bug as not yet fixed.

The report is at `public/framework/ai/sessions/2026/10/20/session-e00f55c9/spawn-parent/review.md`.

**Verdict: pass.** The spawn-parent fix does what the brief asked and can be merged. My report is at `public/framework/ai/sessions/2026/10/20/session-e00f55c9/spawn-parent/review.md`. I didn't run the tests myself; reviewer 3 ran them in a separate copy of the branch and they passed.

- **The cause:** your claude.ai "Servex" connector loads in every agent. It reaches Servex through the remote door, which labels every call `voice-app`. So when an agent spawned through that connector, the spawn was recorded with `voice-app` as its parent.
- **The fix:**
  - Agents that Servex starts can no longer use that connector.
  - When a VS Code tab spawns through the connector and passes its own session id, that id now counts as the parent instead of `voice-app`.
  - A new test, `spawn-parent.test.mjs`, checks five parent cases.
- **The rule is written down:** in `Servex/agents/readme.md`, linked to `doc/architecture.md`, and in `Servex/ext/remote/readme.md`.
- **The task folder can be picked up by someone else now.** This was the open fix in all three earlier reviews. The folder now records the cause, the fix, the test results, and what is left to do and to check.

Remaining notes, none blocking:
- **Write the landing line** after the merge.
- **File the follow-up as a task.** A few other tools (`start_job`, `fork_self`, `follow`, and the spawn permission check) still name `voice-app` when a tab calls them through the connector. Right now this is only mentioned in a log line.
- **Remove an unused `export`** on `tab_parent` in `tools.js`.
- **Check one spawned agent after the Servex restart.** No agent has been spawned since the change, so the connector block is unproven: that agent should not have any `mcp__claude_ai_Servex__*` tools.
- **Update the night notes.** `night-2026-11-01/requirements.md` still lists this bug as not yet fixed; it should link to this task once it lands.
